items.text: Hello Hunters!
Iiiiiiiiiiiiiit’s… Tiiiiiiiiiiiiiiiime!!!!
We couldn't be more excited! This is the first major content update since the 1.0 release and it'll be amazing to see you all returning to Vampire Hunters!

We crafted this new content with a lot of love! We've been listening closely to your feedback, and this update is built around what you asked for the most. You'll be able to play in three new stages, each offering unique challenges and countless new strategies to try out!
Speaking of strategies, this update also introduces a ton of new constellations for you to mix and match, giving you even more ways to shape Vampire Hunters the way you want!
[p align="start"]

[p align="start"]

releases.displayName: Get Ready: Free Major Content Update Coming August 14!

items.text: Hello Hunters!
Sharpen your stakes and stock up on garlic! Our Free Major Content Update is rising from the shadows on August 14!

We've been brewing this update deep in the crypts with plenty of love (and blood), and it's packed with the content you've been asking for. Your feedback has been our spellbook, and we’ve conjured up something that will keep you hooked for hours.
Want to get a taste before the rest? We’re opening the coffin early with a beta test on our Discord! We'll reveal the date soon, so join us there and stay alert.

What’s in the update? Oh, we know you’re dying to find out. And don’t worry, we’ll be unveiling the full list of features and fresh horrors before the big day. Just keep your eyes peeled and your holy water close.
Until then... stay sharp, stay fast, and above all, keep hunting. The night is yours.
Hello Hunters,

This update brings new options that many of you have requested, making your vampire hunting experience even more absurd! We're always listening, so keep sending your suggestions, and we'll continue improving Vampire Hunters!
Added an option to disable score uploads to the leaderboard, allowing you to mess with game as much as you like. This option is located under the Misc tab.
Added options to disable Film Grain and Vignette, found under the Misc tab.
Added an option to limit your FPS, located under the Graphics tab.
Toggle Constant Shoot for Primary Weapons now works with the Gemini Constellation.
Fixed a bug where Constant Shoot would turn on after skipping a cutscene by clicking.
And as always, have a nice hunt.
Cheers!
Hello Hunters,

We are happy to announce a feature that many of you have been requesting for quite some time: Toggle Constant Shoot. With this feature, you'll be able to press the shoot button to toggle between constant shooting all primary weapons and not shooting at all.
We had a blast playing with it! We are sure you will love it too!

We have always loved watching a wacky credits scene. For Vampire Hunters, we knew we wanted to create a credits scene that delivers an absurdly fun and groovy experience after you finish the game. So we are more than happy to present the new and waaay cooler version of the credits song, Hunting Vampires Across the Lands, by the amazing Lukky Sparxx.
Have fun hunting for those vampires across the lands!
Cheers!
Hello Hunters,
It's that time of the year when the nice kids get a special present. We know you all have been great hunters, so we have a special update for you!

Vampire Hunters is in the Christmas mood! Santa engineered some of the weapons so you can help him distribute all the presents. Some enemies and characters are also ready for the Christmas parade, and you can play while listening to two theme songs!
That's not all! We have a special holiday challenge, a lot of bug fixes, and a new season for the leaderboard! Are you ready to get to the top!?

The Christmas theme and holiday challenge will be live until January 6th at 10:00 am PST, so you can have plenty of time to enjoy the special content! Oh, and if you don't enjoy the Christmas theme, you can turn it off by disabling the seasonal content in Settings -> Gameplay.
Winter Madness! You only score when inside the presents area! Play on Yuki Vale without Carina or Hercules and get the highest score.
Like a challenge? Now is your chance to get to the top of the leaderboard!
You can still access last season's leaderboard and check your score and all the highest scores.

And there's more! We have fixed an unintentional exploit that was giving a gigantic boost to some scores. The Ghost is no longer giving extra score when killed in Hercules runs. The Ghost will only give you extra score when killed in mission runs, as that was always our intention.
Have fun in the new season!!
Fixed an issue where the Orb passive weapon was pushing XP and Gold away in Classic Mode.

Fixed a bug that was corrupting the save files. It was linked to the last Hotfix, where we fixed the issue that was causing your character to always reset to Scout when going back to the main menu. If your save has been corrupted due to this issue, you can open the game, and it will automatically restore it.
Fixed a bug where some results were not registering correctly in the leaderboard.
More robust Flamethrower VFX playing behavior to improve the issue of no flame particles.
Fixed Soulstormer projectiles not hitting Eye Tyrant.
Fixed Dracula's Dark Pact Evocation skill (start with Underworld Portal) not working correctly.
Fixed some Japanese text inconsistencies, thanks to the help of our players.
Fixed Contract Gluttony text to reflect its behavior: After that cooldown time, you get two Blood Skill charges.
Fixed Strong and Proud in-game achievement description.
Fixed a Classic Mode in-game achievement text error - from Hunt 350 Phantom Skulls to Hunt 350 Ghost Skulls.
Fixed Shield Generator name; it was Shieldgenerator before.
Fixed Sledgenator level 5 special effect text: "weapon" instead of "weapons".
Fixed Killerfrost level 3 text: "projectiles" instead of "projects".
Fixed Soulstormer level 5 text: this weapon's damage increases instead of your damage increases.
Fixed more Dracula Clone exploits.

notes.title: Unlock the Most Achievements in a Single Run

items.text: It's that simple! Your rank will represent the number of achievements you've unlocked in a run.
The best way to participate is by creating new save slots. This way your in-game progress will be cleared and you'll be able to unlock all the achievements again.
To create a new save slot, go to "Survivors Mode Settings" -> "Save + Load" -> "+ New Slot" (Bottom Right).
You can also check all the achievements in the in-game achievements menu.
Have fun!!!
All revives have an invincibility time of (at least) 5 seconds.

Hello Hunters!
Along with this week’s new challenge, we’re introducing a highly requested feature: the Friends Leaderboard!

Now, you can switch between the Global and Friends Leaderboards, allowing you to compete directly with your Steam friends. So what are you waiting for? Rally your friends and see who can rise to the top as the best Vampire Hunter!

In this week's challenge (from Friday 10:00AM PST to Monday 10:00AM PST), you'll compete for the highest score, playing on any map you choose, using at least the following Constellations: Canis Major, Corona Australis, Eridanus and Horologium. Let's see who is the most skilled Vampire Hunter!
In case you need a refresher on what each of these Constellations does, here’s a quick rundown:
Canis Major: You deal 200% more damage, but every enemy will kill you with a single hit.
Corona Australis: Start with 14 level V weapons, but only relics appear in the shop.
Eridanus: Enemies become 1.5x faster.
Horologium: The game’s clock speeds up 2x, and you gain 2x souls.
As you can see, no mistakes can be made in this challenge… or can they?
And as always, have fun hunting vampires across the lands!!
Hello, Hunters!!
We are all very excited to present to you an amazing new feature for the game:

Vampire Hunters is all about creating the craziest builds to mow down the undead, and finding that absurd combination of weapons, constellations, characters, relics, artifacts, maps and so on IS SUPER SATISFYING!!

To help you find those incredible builds, and enjoy the awesome ways to play the game even more (and, of course, FIGHT TO THE DEATH FOR THE LEADERBOARD RANKS), we are introducing the Weekly Challenge Runs!
Whaaaat are Weekly Challenge Runs, you ask?
Weekly Challenge Runs is where you compete for the best rank in a limited-time CRAZY challenge!
Starting Friday 10am PST, and you have until Monday 10am PST to do you the best you can!
The top players will be presented for all the Brotherhood to see!
You can access the current challenge right from the Main Menu screen in Survivors Mode. If you don't have the requirements, remember to check out the Achievements menu to unlock them!
Get the best score in the Corrupted Necropolis using (at least) the Camelopardalis, Chameleon and Horologium constellations.
In the meantime, have a blast hunting vampires across the lands!!
HELLO HUNTERS!!
This has been an incredible week for us!
We've been having a blast reading all your reviews and comments, watching all the videos and talking with you on our Discord.
And most important, we're SUPER happy you have been enjoying the game!!
The entire team has poured their hearts, souls and bad jokes in the game during the entire development, and specially during the Early Access, where we learned a lot from you hunters.
And reaching more than 200 recent reviews, with a 95% OVERWHELMINGLY POSITIVE RATING has been nothing short of incredibly awesome!!
But the hard work doesn't end here!
We're releasing a small update fixing the most common issues you have been reporting. Keep 'em coming and we'll keep improving the game.

Fixed revive issue where you would not revive even when having remaining revives! It was caused by upgrading a Phoenix or not reaching the Ankh of Osiris' 500 kills with another source of revive active.
Fixed the Little Big Hunter achievement (Finish a map while being at level 1, using manual level up) not triggering if you collected chests.
Fixed reload sound not stopping when Death Reload made you reload (most notable on the Pirate Cannon).
Improved texts to make it more clear that the things that revive you revive you (and count towards the I'm Inevitable achievement)
Fixed The Man Of The Prophecy achievement (it was unlocking with any character not just Berserker).
Fixed the PARKOUR! achievement (it requires finishing Temple of the Night but was unlocking when getting to 25 minutes).
"Press LEFT SHIFT to run" in the Batilla sequence (Classic Mode) now shows up as Left Stick depending on the input device.
Besides more fixes, we have a nice surprise coming for you at the end of the week. Keep an eye out... it's ABSURD!!
In the meantime, keep rockin' and blasting enemies with crazy builds.
Happy hunting!
Hello Hunters,

This update will be a little different from the previous ones because the game content won't change, but the performance will greatly improve, especially in longer runs. So, there isn't much to say except to go ahead and enjoy the game running smoother!
We especially thank our players for helping us identify the causes of performance issues in the game, you rock!

With this feature, you'll be able to see what conditions are currently active in your run, like invincibility, revive charges, slow, frozen, divine shield, and much more. There are also more improvements and bug fixes.
We deeply appreciate your feedback! It's definitely contributing a lot to making Vampire Hunters a spectacular game!

items.text: Added 15 ridiculously awesome new weapons to the Survivors Mode!
Older weapons look more absurd!
New screen shake and weapon recoil.
New super cool enemy "explode on death" animation.
Visual/lighting improvements to the map.
Characters' prestige bonus rebalanced to remove the negative stats.
Visual cooldown for the alternative shots.
Indication of weapons and relics stats progression in the level-up screen.
Leaderboard is reset! (You can access the older score in the game). We'll announce in the next couple of days a super cool contest, so keep an eye on the announcements.
And a lot of polishing, bug fixing, and overall improvements.

All new weapons are available in the Survivors Mode Level Up pool. You won't need to unlock any achievement to start playing with the new weapons in this Major Update. Once we release the new map, all new primary weapons will become characters (so you can start your run with them - in this update, you can only get them during the run). Just another note, some of the new weapons will be unlocked via achievements once we release the new map, but for now, they are all unlocked!
Pirate Cannon: Perfect for those playing the free version of the game. Shoot cannonballs with physics!
Killerfrost: You know that annoying super-fast Werewolf? Now we can cool him down a bit.
Dragoon: Celebrate the New Year with this dragon made of fireworks.
Pewgun: It goes pew pew faster and faster each time. You are no Doctor but you'll be very well armed.
Statikola: The drunken cousin of the Electric Chain, perfect for causing some cheap area damage.
Lightbringer: To bring light to the beings of darkness. No wives were harmed in the forging of this weapon.
Death Ray: Cut enemies with a deadly laser.
Cursed Sword: The sword is hungry, and you need to feed it with the blood of your enemies. With each death, the Cursed Sword becomes more powerful due to the new Imbue perk.
Phoenix: Nothing like a second chance to die once more.
Shield Generator: Introducing the shield mechanic. Press at the right moment and ensure a good chance of survival.
SAM Gun: For all missile fans.
Elemental Pistol: Essentially the Avatar of weapons.
Catapult: Helps to pick off those hordes from a distance while other weapons deal with the frontline.
Thunderstroke: Keep the hordes at a safe distance.
Living Chainsaw: Demons can possess objects, and this one has become the best anti-boss weapon.

Hello, Hunters!
The time has come, Survivors Mode is live!
This new game mode will completely change the way you mow down creatures in Vampire Hunters! Now you have total freedom to move through the map and slay hordes of monsters.

The new mode comes with a new map, an endless level, leaderboards, new Constellations, new monsters, relics, weapons and mini bosses, Prestige level 3 for all characters, new Permanent Upgrades, new weapon's passive effects, a new level up system, combining Constellations and much much more.

We can't wait to hear your thoughts! Don't forget to share your feedback with us. You can use this post, Steam Forums or our Discord (https://discord.com/invite/N8w7PmS). There's a lot more awesomeness coming up!
To celebrate the release we did another episode of our Dev Play series, showcasing some of the goodies from this new update!

Because of the major gameplay differences, our ideia is for you to experience this new game mode almost like a new game. So we separated the game in two different progressions. The first time you open the game, you'll be in the Survivors Mode screen with a new progression. But don't worry about your old progression, once you change to the Classic Mode (you can do that in the main menu), you'll return to your older progression and enjoy the mowing down in the Corridor-style.
Now, let's dive into the details.

This new gameplay allows you to move freely though the map, not just forward in a corridor-style gameplay as before. In this game mode, you will have complete control over the hordes of enemies chasing you, and, of course, mow them down with lots and lots of guns.

Village Yard: The Count has established his castle near a village and is summoning underworld dangers to capture test subjects. Hunter, your mission is to hold off for 30 minutes so the villagers can be evacuated, and then escape in your Hot Air Ballon.

Once you complete the Village Yard, you'll unlock a Constellation that allows you to play the map endlessly, but be wary, the enemies will get stronger after 30 minutes. Can you reach the top of the leaderboard?
The new map comes with a leaderboard! Now you can compete with your friends, and all the Steam players, to see who is the baddest hunter!
Here's the list of all the new underworld dangers you are going to face in the Village Yard:
Sinner
Lost Soul
Punkey
Nijam
Minion
Netherman
Gunlagan
Sultan of Spheres
Ophidic Reaper
Hand of Titan
Uga Bluga
Werewolf
Enraged Werewolf
Armog
During your run, you'll face extra dangers in the form of mini bosses. Each one with a different behavior. Check them out:
Beardedon: A sorcerer that summons meteors at you.
Mantodie: A fast Mentis that punches you.
Skullship: A spaceship controlled by a Skull that shoots you.
Massive Green: A giant plant that keeps summoning Nijans until be destroyed.

When prototyping this new game mode we figured that having an enemy outline (just like a wall hack) would make it super satisfying to move through the map while managing hordes of enemies. We've set a default outline but you can change it or completely turn it off in the gameplay settings.

You can combine your Constellations in the new game mode, allowing you to stack as much Constellations as you wish. Some constellations will also improve your score, so stacking them up with also help you reach the top of the leaderboard.
The new game mode comes with 18 Constellations. You unlock the Constellations by completing new achievements.
Andromeda: Once during a run, the damage that would kill you heals 30% of your MAX HP.
Carina: The waves of enemies are endless and they keep getting stronger.
Cetus: All enemies have double damage and HP and increases your score by 100%.
Canis Major: +100% Damage but enemies deal one-hit kill.
Horologium: Game time is sped up 2x and you gain 2x more souls.
Cassiopeia: The screen is upside down and you have +15% Speed.
Scorpius: You can't heal yourself by any means and increases your score by 30%.
Aquarius: All primary weapons that appear in the store will be the same as your initial one.
Taurus: You can only have your initial primary weapon and increases your score by 50%.
Leo: You can't have any primary weapons and your Secondary weapons have their cooldown reduced by 75%. Increases your score by 100%.
Canis Minor: +0.1 HP/s regen when standing still and no regen at all while walking.
Pegasus: Killing an enemy has a 1% chance to summon meteors near you and increases your score by 25%.

Gemini: You start with an initial weapon in each hand. LMB shoots the weapons from the left hand, and RMB from the right hand. When shooting with one hand, all weapons in the other hand deal +5% damage on their next shot.
Aquila: Combo no longer gives you more blood and instead grants additional damage.
Camelopardalis: All weapon and upgrades choices are random and increases your score by 5%.
Chameleon: Every minute, your weapons change their type randomly, while retaining the same level and increaser your score by 5%.
Perseus: Half chest time and increases your score by 20%.
Orion: All enemies have 2x damage and 4x HP and increases your score by 200%.

Instead of the Blood Rush, you have a different starting blood skill in the Survivors Mode, the Overcharge. While Overcharged your damage is increased by 400% and all of your primary weapons have infinite ammo.

We have combined the old level up system with the Shop system to create a new Level Up System for the Survivors Mode. The weapon progression, relics, rarity and UI works like the Shop, but you don't have a currency anymore. Therefore, the itens don't have a price tag and once you level up, you choose only one item. We have also divided between two different screens, one you choose new primary weapons or upgrades to your current primary weapons and the other one you can choose between relics, passive/secondary weapons and their upgrades. Each time you level up a different screen pops up interchangeably.

From time to time, a Chest will appear on a random location in the map. Don't take too long to get there as they disappear after some time. For this update, the chest will give you a primary weapon level up screen as reward. We have some really cool ideas for chest rewards for future updates.
Just like the Chest, from time to time Health Potions will spawn on Gargoyles spread throughout the map. Unlike the Chest, it won't disappear until you shoot to get it.

All weapons and relics have been revisited to be rebalanced for the Survivors Mode. Now that you can move freely in the map, enemies can have more HP and because of that we had to tweak all the numbers. All Weapons and Relics stayed the same in the Classic Mode (Corridor), the changes will be experienced only in the new mode.

We have also changed how secondary shots works. Instead of consuming your ammo, it will have cooldowns. If you have "no click fire" option on, the secondary shots will be shot automatically after the cooldown (instead of using the right mouse button). If the "no click fire" option is off, you can fire the secondary shots at your will using the right mouse button.

notes.title: We have also added new relics and weapon

items.text: Crucifix Boomerang: A primary weapon that shoots a crucifix that goes forward and comes back, in a straight line, dealing damage along the way.
Infinite Loophole: +0,05 HP/s regen for each active contract.
Leather Glove: +2,5% Reload Speed.
Agility Potion: +5% Reload Speed.
Wood Shield: +1% Armor.
Iron Shield: -2% Speed. +3% Armor.
Thee Full Moon Shield: +5% Armor.

Each character has received a new Reputation Level (Level 3) in the Survivors Mode. You level up your character by starting the run with them. Once you finish your run, your Score will be converted to Reputation Points that will also progress your characters.
You can choose to use your characters' passives or not. You can easily see the passives for each character and for each level (1,2,3) in the character screen once you unlock the character.

The Survivors Mode has some different Permanent Upgrades and a different progression too. You can upgrade your Hunter differently on each mode. In the Survivors mode you still purchase Permanent Upgrades using Reputation Points but the cost of the Permanent Upgrades have also been modified depending on the upgrade level.

We have also changed the way the Score and the conversion to Reputation Level is calculated for the Survivors Mode, making your progression even more smooth. We have also decided to not add the Reborn System to the Survivors Mode. We are focusing the difficulty/strength changes to the Constellations and Prestige Levels.
We have modified most of the screens for the Survivors Mode to accommodate all those changes.

Stage Select: Besides selecting the map, you'll also select your equipped Constellations, check the Leaderboard, your Stats (that are being affected by the Constellations you equip) and the Music you want to be played during your run.

Character Select: Besides selecting your Character, you'll also be able to see all their passive rewards for each of the 3 levels (and also chose to equip or not each passive), your Stats (that are being modified depending on your equipped passives) and a quick settings so you can easily choose to play or not with "no click fire", choose the weapon's screen space and the enemies outline option.
Results: You will be able to see all the details of your run and the achievements you progressed during the run.
Achievements Rewards: Once you go back to the main menu, you are going to see all of the achievements you have unlocked during your run and their respective reward.
We have 45 new achievements for the Survivors Mode. We have selected both the condition and the reward very carefully so you can have a very smooth progression as you play the Survivors Mode.
We have made only one modification in the Classic Mode (Corridor) in this update. We have lowered the amount of monsters you need to kill to get the Monster Extinction Achievement to 200,000.
For the Survivors Mode, we have decided to change how you unlock things in the game.

The game now has two different progressions: one for the Survivors Mode and another for the Classic Mode (Corridor). Nothing has been modified in the Classic Mode (but the achievement mentioned above). We have decided to have separate progressions because of the gameplay differences between the modes. To balance this gameplay difference we had to tweak the weapons, relics, permanent upgrades, Constellations, etc; so it would not work well to have the same progression between the modes. Achievements are also progressing separately between the modes.
You can experience this new game mode almost like a new game, and of course, keep enjoying the awesomeness of the Classic Mode.
All achievements will give you characters (weapons) or itens. Not all weapons and relics will be in the pool of your run in the beginning, you'll need to unlock them as you progress in the game.

Once you unlock a new character, the weapon will automatically appear in your game pool, but to start with this character (to enjoy the passive effects and having this particular weapon from the start) you'll have to purchase the character using a new currency. Besides the permanent upgrade currency (Reputation Points), every time you kill a mini boss (Elite), you'll receive a coin. You can use those coins to purchase the characters.
Wow, it definitely feels like we are adding a entire new game inside Vampire Hunters. We can't wait to see you jumping back in Vampire Hunters to experience all of this awesomeness.

We are working really hard to make Vampire Hunters super awesome and your feedback is of extreme importance for us to achieve that. Please let us know what you think of this new update and the new direction we are taking Vampire Hunters.
And as always, have a nice hunt!
Cheers!
